evidence: The entity perception candidate changed only its target-start source SHA-256 and has a fresh independent exact-data approval. All six candidate source references match current bytes. All 160 approved natural placements use the same condition policy and match their G6 template physical pins. Spatial section 7.1 and the current visibility resolver combine geometry, portal state, target lighting, cover, occlusion, concealment and weather; current entity disclosure requires admitted committed placements and separate player knowledge for names.
excludes: Different G6 or mismatched physical exposure, inferred per-entity observation or recognition, incomplete current facts, unknown policy keys, import, runtime activation and release approval.
